summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions, Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a securities purchase agreement dated May 12, 2026, for a private placement of 12,500,000 Class A shares at $0.12 per share, raising $1.5 million. The offering is conducted under Regulation S. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing describes customary representations and a 24-month lock-up on further equity issuance or registration statements. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
